scripts.app:sync: npm run app:build && cap sync android
scripts.app:apk: npm run app:sync && cd android && .\gradlew assembleDebug

comments.overrides: Forward-pins transitive dependencies of next that carry security advisories. Each is a patched version per its advisory; npm's own `audit fix` would instead downgrade next to 9.3.3. Drop an entry once next ships it directly.
comments.knownUnfixed-sharp: GHSA-f88m-g3jw-g9cj (libvips CVEs) affects sharp <0.35.0, which next pins as an optional dep. Not reachable here: images.unoptimized is on in next.config.ts, so next never invokes sharp to process an image. Do NOT override sharp to 0.35.x either — next declares ^0.34.5 and 0.35 changed the package exports, so it fails to load with ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED. Recheck when next bumps to sharp ^0.35.
comments.knownUnfixed-uuid: GHSA-w5hq-g745-h8pq (moderate) sits in @capacitor/cli > xcode > uuid — desktop dev tooling that runs only during `cap sync`, never in the web bundle or the APK. npm's only fix downgrades @capacitor/cli to 8.4.2. Recheck when Capacitor bumps its xcode dependency.
